body_markdown:
SoundHound AI (SOUN) has officially completed its acquisition of LivePerson, significantly expanding its enterprise AI footprint.


The combination brings together SoundHound's voice and agentic AI with LivePerson's digital messaging capabilities across web, mobile, SMS and social channels.


SoundHound appointed John Collins as CFO of the combined company, specifically emphasizing margin expansion, cost discipline and a path toward sustainable profitability.


##


The Numbers That Stand Out


-


25 Fortune 100 companies now represented in the combined customer base


-


750+ patents across the combined company


-


LivePerson's technology will be integrated into SoundHound's OASYS agentic-AI platform


-


SoundHound says the existing combined customer base represents an opportunity for $500M+ in future revenue


-


LivePerson's outstanding debt was retired as part of the transaction, leaving the combined company debt-free


LivePerson adds another piece of the customer conversation—digital messaging.


That creates a broader platform capable of handling customer interactions across voice + chat + web + mobile + text + social media.


SoundHound now has to prove that a larger platform and customer footprint can translate into better margins and sustainable earnings.
